main.description: A trusted third party's signed attestation that it fetched a delivery's git commit and the content matched at time T — the federated, on-protocol replacement for an escrow agent. Optionally MIRRORS the bytes (`mirror`) so the artifact survives the original repo being force-pushed or deleted. Because this record is itself on-protocol, the witness can't quietly retract; independent witnesses compound durability. Guilds name trusted witnesses in their charter (same pattern as arbiters and labelers). The auditor's `evidence-vanished` flag fires only when a referenced commit is unreachable AND no trusted witness holds it. Author is the witness (repo owner). Written to the witness's repo.

commit.description: Git commit sha (hex) the witness fetched and verified — must match the delivery's source.commit.

treeHash.description: Optional git tree sha the witness records as the content fingerprint.

mirror.description: Optional clone URI where the witness serves the bytes, so the artifact survives the original repo's deletion.

fetchedAt.description: When the witness fetched and verified the commit.
